The '''Reeve's manor''' was the dwelling occupied by the [[reeve]] of [[Quolas]]. Though originally not the largest dwelling in the [[City/Legends|city]], [[Gel Marcolf]] greatly expanded the manor's size and brought in furniture from other [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The manor was located at the city's highest point.<ref name="CotG" />
